mentions.name: Comment Castles
mentions.description: A Reddit clone (social discussion platform) called Comment Castles. The author recently implemented BBCodes-style text formatting with bracket syntax (e.g. b[text here] for bold) supporting bold, italic, underline, highlight, and strikethrough, with composable codes like bui[text here].
mentions.source_excerpt:
My Reddit clone called Comment Castles [0].

Earlier today I implemented "bbcodes" for bold, italic, underline, em (grey background color) and strikethrough.
